paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average probing accuracy for different MLP variations across several hidden layers. The horizontal axis represents the hidden layer configurations, labeled as "hidden:[50], linear," "hidden:[100], ReLU," "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU," and "hidden:[100], ReLU," presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference, ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1; the axis label is "% point difference." Four bars are displayed, each associated with a different hidden layer configuration, colored in alternating shades of blue. The shortest bar, corresponding to "hidden:[50], linear," has an approximate value of -0.1, while the tallest bar, associated with "hidden:[100], ReLU," reaches an approximate value of 0.15. The bar representing "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" has a value of about -0.12, and the bar with the configuration "hidden:[100], linear" approximately reaches a value of -0.18. The bars are not visually emphasized in any particular way; no shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations are present.
